rationale: The existing 900-line spec already covers all seven workflows in the feature doc (builder/SQL create, edit round-trip, sensitivity, lifecycle, detection charts, end-to-end train→detect→alert). The only NEW wired behavior introduced by this diff is budget-mode sensitivity (alert_budget_per_day, edit-only path) plus backend-only recovery notifications and absence kind columns. Budget mode has zero coverage in the spec and zero selectors in the page object, and createAnomalyViaApi does not forward alert_budget_per_day. Appending budget-mode test() blocks into the existing Alerts spec (reusing its beforeEach feature-gate, destination fixture, and ownAnomaly pattern) is the least-duplicative action; no new spec and no ci_matrix registration required.
